title: Irving Leclair, his songs and the Oriental Foxtrot Orchestra
summary: The group recalls pianist Irving Leclair, who wrote Triangle Jazz Blues and Tropical Girl, his health today and a band now playing his tunes.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: That's why they called me a play bar, cause I used to drink beer with you. Did you know Irving Leclair?
Know who? Irving Leclair?
Yeah, Irving Leclair was a nice piano player. That was a guy who played a couple of keys, key of D. He wrote triangle jazz. Sure I remember. Sure I remember. Leclair?
Oh, it was Leclair? Yeah. He was a singer, wasn't he? Piano, pianist.
Piano player. Piano player. He sang too, didn't he? He and Eddie McCarthy had a band. Eddie McCarthy.
Well that's right, but he was playing piano.
He wrote triangle blues and he wrote tropical girl. Yeah. You heard it? Yeah.
Yeah.
Yeah, and then...
He heard it Saturday, huh?
Uh-huh. Well he wrote that. Yeah. And he wrote another fine number. I forgot it's a beautiful thing.
Sure.

Well I was with Tommy Lyman in New York for seven years and a couple months, and a couple of those songs, when he found out I knew those songs he used and was crazy about them. Well how am I doing? Fine. I'm great.
Erwin Leclair has moved out to Jefferson Parish now. No, Orvin's not living.
Erwin Leclair? Yes he is.
Last time I talked to him he was alive. Well I'll be damned. Tell him hello for me.
I will.
But he's getting very forgetful. Yeah. Oh yes. But you know, he has good moments and bad moments.
Last time I seen Orvin was waiting for the electric company here.
Yeah, his daughter plays piano now. She does, yeah.
Well somebody told me he had died. I thought...

No, not that I've heard of and I keep in touch with him and I see him, because there's a band here that plays my wonderful Tropical Girl and Triangle Jazz Blues. Beautiful though. And they had a recording session, he went to it on Saturday, I didn't make it.
The New Leviathan, the original? No, the New Leviathan. New Leviathan.
The Oriental Foxtrot Orchestra. And they do all those numbers like Dardanella and as well as a lot of the local numbers. They do Purple, Rosa, Cairo sometimes.
